description: Next.js App Router, Server Components first, TypeScript and Tailwind.

component.description: Server Component (default choice) in its own kebab-case folder with an index barrel.

element.description: Semantic root element. Pick the most meaningful one (button for actions, a for navigation, nav/section/article for regions); div only when nothing else fits.

variants.description: Add cva variant/size props (shadcn style) and export <name>Variants.

as-child.description: Add asChild (Radix Slot) so callers can render it as their own element, e.g. a link.

cn.description: Import path of the repo's cn() helper. Auto-detected from components.json or lib/utils; pass only to override.

with-test.description: Add a Testing Library test (sync components only).

client-component.description: Client Component ('use client') for state, effects, event handlers or browser APIs. Keep it a small leaf.

element.description: Semantic root element. Pick the most meaningful one (button for actions, a for navigation, nav/section/article for regions); div only when nothing else fits.

variants.description: Add cva variant/size props (shadcn style) and export <name>Variants.

as-child.description: Add asChild (Radix Slot) so callers can render it as their own element, e.g. a link.

cn.description: Import path of the repo's cn() helper. Auto-detected from components.json or lib/utils; pass only to override.

context.description: Client context + Provider + guarded useThing() hook. Mount the provider as deep in the tree as possible.

util.description: Pure utility function in lib/. Use --server-only for code that must never reach the client bundle.

route.description: App Router segment: page.tsx plus optional layout/loading/error. --name is the route path, e.g. blog/[slug] or (marketing)/about.

with-loading.description: Add loading.tsx (Suspense fallback for the segment).

api-route.description: Route Handler (route.ts) under app/api. --name is the path below /api, e.g. users/[id].

with-test.description: Add a handler test that calls GET with a Request.

server-action.description: Server Action module ('use server') for mutations called from forms or client components.

form-field.description: react-hook-form field on the shadcn form primitives: label, control, description and error wired for a11y. Validation lives in the form's zod schema. Always a Client Component.

control.description: Which shadcn control the field renders.

with-test.description: Add a Testing Library test inside a Form harness.
